overview_description.description:
Net Zero Build offers an AI-driven platform designed to streamline and automate the sustainable building certification process. 
Our AI-powered platform helps real estate project teams navigate certification requirements efficiently and collaborate effectively with all stakeholders involved, significantly enhancing productivity and reducing administrative costs. 
We aim to empower the real estate industry with the right digital tools to increase their positive environmental impact and contribute to global climate change mitigation efforts.
